endcard: Save this for the day you face your own fire

save.ar: يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
save.tr: “O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham.”

lines.say: They built a fire to throw one young man into. Then Allah spoke to the fire.
Ibraaheem, peace be upon him, broke their idols, and asked: why worship what can't benefit or harm you?
lines.cap: Ibrahim (peace be upon him) broke their idols and asked: why worship what can't benefit or harm you?

lines.say: With no answer left, they said: burn him.
lines.cap: With no answer left, they said: “Burn him.”

lines.say: And Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibraaheem.
lines.cap: Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.

lines.say: Ibn Abbaas said: had Allah not said, and safety, the cold itself would have harmed him.
lines.cap: Ibn Abbas: had Allah not said “and safety,” the cold itself would have harmed him.

lines.say: They wanted to harm him, but Allah made them the greatest losers.
lines.cap: They wanted to harm him, but Allah made them the greatest losers.

lines.say: So whatever fire you're facing, don't stare at the flames. Turn to the One they obey.
lines.cap: Whatever fire you're facing, don't stare at the flames. Turn to the One they obey.

lines.say: Save this, and send it to someone facing their own fire.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone facing their own fire 🤍

v1.ar: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
v1.tr: “We [i.e., Allāh] said, ‘O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham.’”

v2.tr: “And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.”
